_note: Trimmed from one run of scripts/landmarks_probe.py (2026-10-12): a search near Colonia, each answer's count and its first results. Findings: search results carry landmarks (species, variant, place), earth_masses, radius and the journal's surface_temperature; system dumps carry no landmarks; the landmark filter is {landmarks: [{subtype}]} (landmark_subtype {value} too; {landmarks: {value}} finds nothing); surface_temperature needs {value: [lo, hi], comparison: '<=>'} ({min, max} is ignored); one system's bodies: distance max 1 ly from it (a max of 0 and a system_name filter are ignored). Each body's landmarks cut to one per species and variant; materials left out. Added later the same day (S29): {landmarks: [{subtype, variant}]} filters by colour too (Bacterium Vesicula near Colonia: 741 bodies, 144 with Mulberry, 149 with Lime, every result of that colour).
